text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It feels as if the plum-scented breeze is blowing through the air today. Lunch should be delicious.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: But where should I eat?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wait a secooond!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Zephyr! You've earned yourself a "Lunch with the Class Representative" ticket!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: A ticket… to lunch with you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes! As class rep, I'm always in very high demand at lunchtime!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: But don't be shy! Because for today's lunch period, you have me ALL to yourself!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Whoa! This place feels so nice! It's perfect for our lunch together!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes, that'll be the sunlit breeze. Only… it feels a little weaker than usual today. That's a shame.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh. Worry not! I've come prepared! Knowing how much you enjoy the wind, I went and borrowed this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Now, go ahead and enjoy your meal while savoring the breeze!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Fan fan fan fan!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh… Some leaves have fallen onto my food.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hwah?! How could this happen?! I'm so terribly sorry!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Don't worry. That's just how the wind blows. And it's a refreshing breeze… one that truly captures the season.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh! So does that mean you're not mad?! How kindhearted you are!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hm? I was simply sharing a passing thought.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Nnngh! And you're modest to boot! As class rep, however, I cannot let things end like this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: If there's anything I can do to assist you, please let me know! I will solve any problem you present to me!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: There is one thing… Would you mind telling me where the source of your whirling vortex is located?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Here! This is the "whirling vortex" you're talking about, yes? Go ahead, behold the swirl of my hair whorl!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Interesting… So even our comprehension of the concept differs.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: All right, then let me ask you one more thing. How do you maintain such vigorous circulation?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Simple! A healthy head of hair is maintained through daily washing! Don't forget to use your fingers to thoroughly massage your scalp!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: So, you drive away the dark winds with daily stimulation. Perhaps adopting the lulling winds of your perspective would help me generate my own vortex…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Of course it would! Just be sure to work the shampoo into suds! If you're worried about it getting in your eyes, wear a shampoo visor! Don't be embarrassed—I use one too!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That was… quite the sudden scud. I feel as if you've blown a veil from over my eyes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as lunch break is ending, I spot Yamanin Zephyr and Sakura Bakushin O having a lively conversation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Judging from their empty lunch boxes, it looks like they ate together.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, hello. Yes, I was with Bakushin O. She taught me a great deal.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh. Ask me anything you want! As class rep, I'll answer your every question with panache!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: She's truly a vigorous gale of a person. She even told me the secret of her whirling vortex.
choice_data_list: Let's ask for her secret to winning races too.
We'd better train you up so she doesn't blaze past you!
We'd better train you up so she doesn't blaze past you!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: She's truly a vigorous gale of a person. She even told me the secret of her whirling vortex.
choice_data_list: Let's ask for her secret to winning races too.
We'd better train you up so she doesn't blaze past you!
We'd better train you up so she doesn't blaze past you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I can answer that! The secret to my strength is that I'm in Bakushin Mode 24/7!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: From the moment I wake up to the second my head hits the pillow, I'm in Bakushin Mode! Even during lunchtime, it's BAKUSHIN BAKUSHIN for me!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: A burster that blows on without end! So that's the secret to your strength…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr learns all about Sakura Bakushin O's Bakushin mindset!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes… That way, I can create a whirling vortex of my own!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Feel free to use mine as a reference!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later on, Yamanin Zephyr shows up to training wearing a different expression from usual.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Let's get started, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I watch her, I sense in her an intense determination to win! She must be picturing her rival in her mind's eye…
